jobs.title: Principal Associate, Product Management
jobs.description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,

Principal Associate, Product Management

About Capital One Canada
For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated. Leveraging the power of data and technology, we’re where product professionals come to solve complex problems and shape customer experiences that have influence across industries.

Here, you’ll shape customer experiences and take transformative ownership of strategies that propel us into the future, creating value at a scale that directly accelerates our growth. If you’re ready to redefine what’s possible, to turn insights into experiences that make a real-world impact, this is where you can create what’s next.

About the Team
At Capital One Canada, our Product Management team is on a mission to redefine financial well-being and empower millions of Canadians by improving access to credit. We don’t just manage roadmaps or check boxes—we fall in love with complex problems and take true ownership of business outcomes.

Collaboration is at the heart of how we deliver bold, industry-leading customer experiences. Working closely with cross-functional partners in Tech, Data, Strategy, and Design, we balance fast-paced innovation with multi-layered risk to shape products that drive meaningful impact. If you thrive on autonomy, continuous learning, and building what’s next, you’ll fit right in.
About the Role
Here are a few of the ways our Product Managers are helping people create meaningful interactions with Capital One:
- Give customers the confidence to apply without rejection with Quick Check, our credit card eligibility tool.

- Enhance the credit card application experience to encourage early adoption of digital habits.

- Manage and scale data and machine learning platforms across the organization to deliver smart, personalized experiences.

- Create easy digital solutions that help customers address fraud and easily get back to using their card.

- Develop assistance programs to help customers who are struggling with their payments

- Provide customers with relevant details about their account, conveniently within the mobile app.

Your Responsibilities:
As a Product Manager,  you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in four key areas:
- Human Centered
- You’ll lead sourcing and synthesis of customer discovery efforts to understand customer needs to drive the long term vision for your product

- You’ll turn these customer insights into actionable strategies that will define the priorities for your team and rally your stakeholders to your vision

- Business Focused
- You’ll own and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver on business outcomes, working closely with a cross-functional team to ensure that all the right resources are aligned to ensure that and your team will be successful

- You’ll define KPIs for your product and will be responsible for measuring and tracking to those measures, with an eye to adjusting and refining your roadmap as the data dictates

- Technology Driven
- You’ll have an end-to-end understanding of your product and how it fits into the larger ecosystem to be able to anticipate impacts from changes in other parts of the business

- You’ll work closely with tech leadership and architecture to understand the tradeoffs of technical decisions and how they impact the ultimately customer experience your team will deliver always looking to ensure you’re using the best tool for the job

- Transformational Leadership
- You’ll rally your teams and senior stakeholders to your product vision and proactively leverage relationships throughout the ecosystem to align to your vision and influence prioritization across partner teams

We want you if you are:
- Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore and you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.

- Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Your team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You can always rally associates to work with you.

- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work.

- Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs.

- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help.

- Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships.

Basic Qualifications:
- At least 3 years of Product Management experience with software products

- Experience successfully delivering a software product

- Strong quantitative and qualitative skills; able to make data-driven decisions and provide recommendations to drive action

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or related field

- 5+ years of experience of Product Management experience

- Experience in financial services, technology or operations

Working at Capital One
You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.
- Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.

- Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

- Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
The expected annual salary range for this position is $134,400- $153,300. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

We embrace the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI as every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers, business interviewers, and recruitment professionals. Our teams are equipped with training that empowers them to use AI responsibly.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Analyst - Product Analytics
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Data Analyst - Product Analytics

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

The Enterprise Data team is focused on maximizing the value of our data ecosystem and enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built on a scalable, future ready foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional team working across Product, Technology, Design, Risk, and other partners to build a modern enterprise data ecosystem.

We are looking for an exceptional and innovative Sr. Manager, Data Analytics to solve complex business and product challenges across our Enterprise Data Product teams. You will lead Product Analytics to measure and improve the performance and health of our Products and Platforms, transforming complex data into actionable, AI-enabled insights that shape product strategy and drive better decisions. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex problems and using Data and AI to influence product development, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

On a given day you will be:
- Refining a new Enterprise-wide analytical tools validation framework
- Planning and executing validation projects
- Assessing the quality and risk of analytical tool methodologies across Capital One, and the nature of tools usage within those processes
- Understanding technical issues in analytical tools and assessing tools risks and opportunities
- Independently researching, identifying, and prototyping industry best practices for emerging analytical tools
- Communicating results clearly and concisely both verbally and through written communications via validation reports and presentations
- Leveraging education, colleagues and training opportunities to develop solutions to business problems
- Coaching and mentoring junior staff

An ideal candidate will possess strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams.

Basic Qualifications:
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 7 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
- At least 5 years of experience performing professional data analysis work
- At least 5 years of experience leading and developing with open source data technologies
- At least 2 years of experience managing people

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s Degree or PhD in a Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field
- At least 7 years of experience in statistical or econometrics hands-on work
- At least 5 years of experience manipulating and performing analysis with large data sets
- At least 5 years of experience in financial services industry
- At least 5 years of experience in developing statistical or econometric models
- At least 5 years of experience in validating statistical or econometric models
- At least 2 years of experience with data governance
- At least 2 years of experience with predictive analytics

At Capital One, risk management is not just part of the business, it is the business. Senior Manager, Product Management (PXDP55)
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. About the Team
As part of the Global Payment Network's AI Enablement Program, you will lead the centralized use case strategy that powers how GPN builds, scales, and governs AI across the Network. You will own the end-to-end pipeline from ideation to production — identifying and prioritizing the highest-impact AI use cases across Product, Tech, and Business functions.

You oversee the development of the GPN Knowledge Base and Context Engine — a centralized, AI-accessible single source of truth consolidating code, contracts, policies, specs, and controls that today live across Mainframe and Cloud codebases, SharePoint, Google Drive, and more. This includes partnering with 15+ functions across the Network to extract and validate requirements, close documentation gaps, and curate validated context graphs that power agentic development, PRD-to-code mapping, and audit-ready traceability — all while keeping humans in the loop.

This role sits at the center of the Program's Strategic Delivery pillar, partnering closely with Governance, Training, and Tooling counterparts to ensure new use cases move from pilot to BAU in a well-managed way. jobs.description:
Director, Technical Program Management

Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

About The Team:
The Frontier of AI & Solutions TPM team is at the forefront of driving innovation by accelerating Generative AI (GenAI) from cutting-edge research into secure, compliant, and scalable enterprise-scale production. We own and advance core platforms and high-impact solutions, establishing the definitive enterprise guardrails and delivery pathways that enable safe, accelerated AI adoption across the entire company.
We are seeking an exceptional Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive programs at the intersection of Generative AI research and production-scale deployment. This role will focus on multi-agent conversational systems, agentic AI architectures, inference optimization, and model pretraining/finetuning workflows. You will collaborate closely with world-class researchers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to take cutting-edge AI models from concept to production, while ensuring alignment with risk, compliance, and business objectives.

What You’ll Do:
As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products & platforms that will help Capital One customers have incredible experiences.

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.
- Contribute to the organization’s TPM / Delivery strategy: establish operating mechanisms, maturity models, and tooling that scale across portfolios
- Drive development of and alignment on program roadmap anchored in business objectives, definition of done, technical solutions, and sequencing of dependencies
- Lead cross-platform technical investment planning and ensure architectural alignment toward long-term platform convergence and reuse
- Serve as an executive-level escalation point for program risks, influencing technology leaders to make data-driven tradeoffs between speed, cost and resiliency
- Ensure definition of measurable outcomes of platform success (availability, scalability, cost efficiency, developer velocity) and ensure delivery accountability across multiple engineering teams

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in a technical field
- At least 7 years of experience managing technical programs

Preferred Qualifications:
- 7+ years of experience designing and building solutions using distributed computing  or service oriented architecture (SOA)
- 3+ years of experience in building distributed systems & highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture - preferably using AWS
- 3+ years experience building highly scalable products & platforms
- 3+ years of experience with Agile delivery
- 3+ years years experience delivering large and complex programs - where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables and unblock teams to land business impact
- Experience in building systems & solutions within a highly regulated environment
- MBA or Master’s Degree in a related technical field (Computer Science, Software Engineering)
- PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
- 3+ years of people management experience or influencing organization as an IC
- Experience driving platform standardization across multiple product portfolios or lines of business
- Track record of building TPM maturity (operating models, career frameworks, metrics) at scale within engineering organizations
- Exceptional communication and influence skills, capable of engaging deeply with technical teams while translating implications into compelling business narratives that persuade senior leadership

Senior Director, eData Product Analytics and Enablement

The Role
At Capital One, data and analytics are at the center of everything we do. It has been the essence of Capital One since our founding and is deep in our DNA. Our innovation and passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 100 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision making. We're delivering best-in-class innovation so that our 100 million customers - and counting - can manage their finances with ease. Our reality and vision empower us to use artificial intelligence and machine learning to transform real-time data, software, and algorithms into financial clarity. We build our own products and release them with a speed and agility that allows us to get new customer experiences to market quickly. We are leveraging data and analytics to build a better business model, and even though we are leading the industry, we feel there is so much more to be done to fully transform banking and financial services.

As the Senior Director, Product Analytics and Enablement within the Office of the Chief Data Officer (OfCDO), you will lead a key organizational pillar responsible for delivering critical analytical and operational leverage to the product teams building Capital One’s enterprise data products, platforms and tools. You will build the overarching strategy for this pillar and deliver impact that ultimately reaches across the enterprise. You will lead the evolution of an AI-enabled analytics operating model with team members embedded with their product partners, scale self-service product analytics, and evolve the product operations within Enterprise Data to accelerate product delivery. You will oversee about 30 data analysts and operational / program managers.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the eData Product Analytics and Enablement pillar, including the Product Analytics and Product Enablement functions
- Build the long-term strategy for the Product Enablement function in close collaboration with the product teams and rapidly identify and implement operational improvements
- Drive the transition and operationalization of an embedded operating model, placing team members directly into product domain workflows to enhance contextual alignment and agility
- Scale an AI-enabled analytics operating model that automates routine reporting and shifts data analyst capacity toward high-value insight generation and decision support
- Establish self-service product analytics data infrastructure with standardized, production-ready metrics and AI-ready semantic standards across enterprise platforms
- Oversee project management, stakeholder engagement, and demand and delivery coordination for product domains, including evolving these activities over time as part of the product enablement strategy this role will develop
- Foster a strong culture of analytics excellence, continuous learning, and talent development across data analysis and program management job families

The person will:
- Demonstrate expertise in product analytics and product operations
- Exhibit exceptional influencing and cross-functional leadership skills to partner effectively across product, technology, and risk domains
- Possess proven experience driving AI fluency and integrating AI tools/agents into analytical and operational workflows
- Display a passion for coaching and developing a team through a clear, consistent leadership style

Product Management
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:
- Human Centered  - You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
- You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

- Business Focused  - Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
- You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

- Technology Driven  - You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
- You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
- You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

- Transformational Leadership  - By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
- You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

- Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
- Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
- Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help

Business Cards & Payments (BC&P) | Build the Future.
At BC&P, we bring a builder's mindset to work, just like the business owners we serve. Small businesses are a different kind of customer. We own the work end to end, turning today's insights into tomorrow's results, together.
- We're relentlessly curious.
- We ask the hard questions.
- We make space for the best ideas to win

Because that's how we create impact we can be proud of.

Show us how you've used Al to learn, build, and solve problems beyond basic text generation.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:
- Human Centered  - You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
- You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

- Business Focused  - Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
- You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

- Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges

- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
- Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
- Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

jobs.title: Head of PMO & Product Operations
jobs.description:
Head of PMO & Product Operations

As the Head of PMO & Product Operations at Capital One, you will build and run the operating backbone for a complex, multi-team organization. That means owning how work flows, how capacity gets planned and allocated, where the system can run leaner, and how this organization connects with the other organizations it depends on and serves. You will work with senior leaders across the company to shape an operating model built to scale, then lead a team that turns that model into steady, repeatable execution.

About the Team:
This team operates a portfolio of product and risk operations teams with roughly 200 associates that drive impact across our entire enterprise.  The leader in this org will play a key horizontal role across various verticals reporting directly to the Managing Vice President of Product.

Responsibilities of the Head of PMO & Product Operations:
- Owning the operating model for the organization: how priorities are set, how capacity is planned, and how work is sequenced and tracked across teams
- Driving efficiency and capacity management across the system: identifying bottlenecks, rebalancing load, and ensuring the organization's resourcing matches its highest priority commitments
- Designing and running the mechanisms (planning cycles, governance forums, reporting cadences) that give leadership visibility into delivery health, risk, and tradeoffs as they emerge
- Serving as the connective layer between this organization and the ones it interconnects with: aligning dependencies, surfacing cross-org risks early, and brokering tradeoffs so commitments made across boundaries actually hold
- Leading and developing a team of program and project managers and operations associates, setting the standards and tools they use to manage complex, dynamic work
- Partnering with senior stakeholders to translate strategy into an executable plan, and refining that plan as priorities and constraints shift
- Building scalable, repeatable processes that cut down on ad hoc firefighting and make the organization more predictable over time

The person will:
- Think in systems: able to see how capacity, dependencies, and incentives interact across an organization, not just within a single project
- Exhibit outstanding influencing skills to drive alignment across teams and leaders who do not report to them
- Bring a proven track record of standing up or significantly maturing a PMO, operations, or similar operating model function
- Display a passion for coaching and developing a team through a clear, consistent leadership style
- Communicate with precision and credibility at all levels: translate operational complexity into clear choices for executives, and clear direction for teams

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience
- At least 10 years of project management experience
- At least 5 years of people management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Masters / MBA degree
- 12+ years of project management experience
- 6+ years of people management experience
- PMP, Lean, Agile or Six Sigma certification
- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills
- Excellent problem solving and influencing skills

jobs.description:
Manager, Cyber Security Product Owner

Capital One is seeking a product owner to help deliver game-changing cybersecurity solutions based on threat, data, and design thinking. At Capital One, we believe in the values of Excellence and Doing the Right Thing. We are a technology-oriented company delivering financial products to market through modern technology and constant innovation at a massive scale.  Part of that innovation is leveraging technology to deliver the best cybersecurity solutions for our business.

As a Product Owner supporting the Cryptographic Services in the Data Protection domain, you will be accountable for contributing to and delivering upon the strategic agenda for our core cyber products to drive meaningful progress for our customers and our business. In this capacity, you will drive product vision into our development teams, translate vision into delivery objectives, provide customer-informed guidance to shape products, and work with cross-functional teams to deliver well-managed and sustainable features that bring that vision to life. You will use your deep technical knowledge and subject matter expertise in cybersecurity, software and systems engineering to drive impactful improvements to our cyber capabilities.

What you’ll do:
- Communicate the delivery roadmap to our technology teams by inspiring the team through the product vision
- Clearly articulate and advocate target persona, customer benefit, and value of features across teams
- Leverage technical knowledge and skills on how systems work and how code is built to effectively support engineering teams in delivering value
- Utilize strong background in PKI, encryption algorithms, data protection products and practices in public cloud and customer research and insights to represent the voice of the customer to the engineering team(s)
- Incorporate design thinking and analytics to inform product design
- Actively participate in research or design sessions for new features and new cryptographic domains like post quantum cryptography.
- Contribute to the development of a healthy product backlog, collaborating with the Product Manager, Engineering, and Solution Architects to break down business epics, document user stories (to also include things like addressing technical debt, SRE, etc.), design details and comprehensive acceptance criteria
- Lead internal backlog refinement sessions to refine cyber and customer intent, prepare business epics and stories for technical breakdown and planning, and ensure requirements are well understood by the engineering teams
- Prioritize the Product Backlog to maximize business and customer outcomes by balancing technical and non-technical aspects while also incorporating cyber and operational risk reduction outcomes and activities
- Act as a technical advisor to the product manager, engineering, and other stakeholders
- Collaborate across multiple cross-functional teams and the Product Owner community and play a key role in key Agile and SAFe ceremonies
- Support teams through escalation and resolution of impediments
- Drive performance and innovation with data-driven insights
- Proactively identify opportunities when key metrics on security, resilience and performance for your product (s) are not performing
- Maintain technical and risk credibility with your own team(s) and with partners across our technology organization

About you:
- You believe that a core component of security’s role is to enable the business, not just to secure it, and the solutions you bring to life are aligned to the needs of our developer community, customers, and business partners.

- You seek to create enduring value by delivering reusable, extensible and resilient cybersecurity capabilities to address the evolving threat landscape
- You actively solve cyber technical challenges in collaboration with engineering.
- You are naturally curious and stay on top of emerging trends and threats especially in the data protection space.
- You have a comprehensive understanding of iterative software delivery to connect effectively and in a meaningful way with software and platform engineers
- You seek to understand the business and technology landscape and cross-functional dependencies to inform product vision and integration with larger organizational goals
- You are a clear thinker, thrive in working across teams, and an expert in dealing with ambiguity.

- You understand and track key metrics on security, resilience and performance for your product (s) and understand levers that drive these metrics
- You have strong consulting and analytical skills and a risk management mindset
- You have the ability to foster collaborative, open working relationships with technology partners and other stakeholders
- You demonstrate balanced judgment in decisions and incorporate risk factors accordingly
- You have a strong bias for action

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree
- At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity or information technology
- At least 4 years of experience evaluating, contributing to, or supporting development of cybersecurity capabilities

Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in cryptography
- 6+ years of experience solving cyber technical challenges
- 4+ years of experience translating business strategy and analysis into products
- 6+ years of Cyber product owner experience
- 2+ years of experience in technical writing
- 2+ years of experience in scaled agile product management
- 2+ years of experience of cloud products like AWS KMS or CloudHSM
- Experience in regulated financial services organizations or tech companies
- 2 or more professional certifications (SAFe PM/PO, CISSP, GIAC (various), CISM, CCSP, AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Security)

jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Product Management - Capital One Luxury Travel

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.
We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

Role Description & Key Responsibilities
As a Product Manager in Luxury Travel, you will balance end-to-end execution with cross-functional stakeholder management—driving high-impact initiatives and aligning teams across travel booking portals.
- Work with internal stakeholders and external partners to build the future of Capital One Luxury Travel.
- Manage a tech team in partnership with another product manager, leading high-priority and complex tech integrations, building a bespoke premium E2E travel experience for our customers.
- Develop and deliver on best in class testing strategies to ensure that we consistently launch the highest performing product features.
- Enable growth by leading tech integrations with external partners in the luxury travel space.
- Put the best of travel booking technology into the hands of millions who are excited for revenge travel in 2026 and beyond. You’ll be responsible for expanding access to the travel portal, creating seamless experiences for users along the way.
- Dream up and deliver on new travel features and experiences, developing the product strategy and backlog for Capital One Travel.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:
- Human Centered  - You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
- You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

- Business Focused  - Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
- You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

- Technology Driven  - You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
- You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
- You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

- Transformational Leadership  - By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
- You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:
- Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
- Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
- Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
- Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or military experience
- At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
- 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products
- 1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences
- 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

About the Team:
As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM) on Capital One’s Enterprise Data team, you will execute on high priority enterprise level initiatives, influence across our organization and drive the implementation of Capital One’s future API strategies. - 3+ years of experience with Agile delivery

jobs.description:
Manager, Product Manager - In Person Transactions

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About the Team
Capital One is reimagining how customers bank in person. Our ATM and in-person banking technology organization builds the software platforms behind a nationwide fleet of ATMs, self-service kiosks, and branch network devices, moving the experience from reliable cash access toward real-time, intelligent,
customer-first interactions.

The In-Person Transactions (IPT) team is redefining the technology that powers our customers' physical financial touchpoints where our customers interact with their money. We operate at the critical intersection of digital software and physical hardware, managing the full ATM stack and the broader ecosystem of in-person banking. While this space has traditionally relied on rigid hardware constraints, we're aggressively rethinking the status quo, building software-driven solutions that treat physical devices as intelligent, connected endpoints rather than static machines. By prioritizing a digital-first architecture, we're transforming everyday transactions into seamless digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the physical-to-digital ecosystem.

As a Product Manager for IPT, you'll step into a high-impact, senior individual contributor role driving two critical and complex initiatives.

- First, you'll spearhead the zero-to-one launch of a net-new product at the intersection of digital experiences and physical money movement. The core challenge, and the excitement of this build, lies in untangling intricate physical and servicing dependencies to engineer a seamless digital experience. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, user research, and design to solve complex customer and business challenges and bring a groundbreaking product to market.

- Second, you'll lead the evolution of our ecosystem by building advanced, data-centric features. You'll leverage our rich data sets and explore opportunities to integrate machine learning and generative AI to uncover operational efficiencies and build intelligent connections across our systems. This is a chance to architect smart, predictive solutions that strip away legacy constraints and redefine how intelligently and autonomously our systems operate.

You'll set direction across both areas, balancing net-new strategic bets against platform modernization, reliability, and compliance work. It's a high-exposure role spanning data platforms, payments, observability, and security, with regular interaction across engineering, design, operations, and senior leadership.

Senior Manager, Product Management

Capital One India is looking to hire a Sr. Manager, Product Management for AI/ML Model Monitoring and Governance to join the Machine Learning Experience (MLX) team!

At Capital One India, we work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment to solve fundamental business problems at scale. Using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning, we derive valuable insights about product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and more from large volumes of data, and use it to build cutting edge patentable products that drive the business forward. Product Management at Capital One is a critical, vibrant craft that requires a blend of entrepreneurial drive, keen business acumen, customer experience obsession, technical depth and strong people leadership.

The MLX team is at the forefront of how Capital One builds and deploys responsible GenAI and ML models; we onboard and educate associates on the GenAI and ML platforms and products that the whole company uses; we drive new innovation and research; and we’re working to seamlessly infuse Generative AI and ML into the fabric of the company. The AI experience we're creating is the foundation upon which our lines of business will continue to deliver next-generation machine learning-driven products and services for our customers.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Develop and communicate the product vision and strategy for your area of responsibility

- Deeply understand the needs of data scientists, machine learning engineers and model risk officers across Capital One

- Partner with business and technology leadership to align on prioritization of key problems to be solved to maximize business and customer outcomes

- Collaborate with teams in India and USA to drive alignment with different teams working on the platform

- Incorporate design thinking and analytics to inform product design

- Maintain a healthy backlog of work and play a critical role in many agile ceremonies.

- Support the team with escalation and resolution of impediments

- Serve as the connection between Customers, Capital One’s mission, and Tech. Partners

- Collaborate with the design team and guide their investments for research, prototyping, experimentation, and overall design thinking.

- Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results, as appropriate, to a spectrum of audiences, from internal stakeholders to executives, employees to end-users.

We want you if:
- You are interested in building lasting relationships with peers and having fun while building products that delight customers and drive value to the business.

- You enjoy putting yourself in the shoes of customers to identify their pain points and then collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve these customer challenges. Even better if you have experience doing this for data scientists and machine learning engineers.

- You are a learner who is able to quickly get up to speed in a highly technical environment.

- Passionate about building a well-rounded product management skill set that is human centered, business focused, and technology driven with an emphasis on integrated problem solving and people leadership.

- You are experienced working in an Agile environment.

- You are a do-er who can also zoom out and think strategically.

- You have excellent oral and written communication skills.

- You are highly collaborative and have the ability to influence and lead.

jobs.description:
Senior Business Manager - AIML Product Strategy

About Capital One :

At Capital One, we have been relentlessly innovating since Day 1. We are a nationally recognized brand and a leading tech company touching over 100 million households. Founder-led, Capital One has grown to annualized ~$75 billion in revenue in just over 20 years.

We consider ourselves the bank a technology company would build. We are the only large bank who is all-in on the cloud, and we build our own software, contributing heavily to the open-source community. We are at the frontier of AI not just in our industry, but in the world at large. Our world-class AI and ML talent (Ranted #1 in the Evident AI index for AI Talent) shapes the frontier of AI; we are in the top 5 US organizations in AI patent application volume – and our papers are routinely featured at top AI conferences (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS, etc.).

Many companies claim to be tech companies – we actually live it.

About the team & role:

The Enterprise AI and Machine Learning (AIML) team builds the AI & ML platforms that our company leverages to build all things AI. The platforms deliver the infrastructure, foundation models, and a host of reusable capabilities that enable teams to build cutting-edge AI use cases across the business servicing, marketing, credit underwriting, fraud detection, and more. Capital One is a platform company, and these platforms are the de-facto way to build with AI at Capital One.

As a Senior Business Manager on Capital One’s AIML Product Strategy team, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to shape the destination of AI at Capital One.

You will work alongside a team of strategists and our AIML senior leadership to identify the key leverage points and define the strategy for our world-leading organization. You will solve critical business problems, and help us shape Capital One’s AI strategy, in support of our mission to be at the Frontier of AI. You will do it all as part of a highly collaborative, agile team environment - where you will unlock tremendous learning and growth.

Key focus areas:
- Setting the destination vision for our AI & ML platforms, working alongside leaders in our AI organization and business

- Working back from our customers and internal partners, to identify the outcomes we seek and the reusable capabilities and services we need

- Build storylines and materials to roll out our AIML strategy across the company

- Help bring our vision to life by working with stakeholders in our lines of business and our AIML teams on “on-the-ground” problem solving

- Shaping our strategy and the continuous delivery and improvement of our AI platform capabilities

Who we are looking for:

We are looking for a general athlete, strategic and analytical thinker, and a world-class communicator. This role will require exceptional strategic thinking, high learning agility in the domain of AI, the ability to influence senior leaders, and the great teamwork in leading and working alongside a team of strategists.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree

- At least 3 years of experience performing quantitative analysis

Sr. Associate, Product Management - Auto

Product Management
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:
- Human Centered  - You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design
- You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

- Business Focused  - Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs
- You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

- Technology Driven  - You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology
- You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers
- You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

- Transformational Leadership  - By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams
- You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:
- Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
- Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
- Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
- Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or military experience
- At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering
- 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products
- 1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences
- 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

Director, Product Development, AI Enablement

Director, Product Management (PXDP60)

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About the Team
The Enterprise Data team is dedicated to maximizing the value of our data ecosystem, enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built upon a scalable and future-proof foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional organization. Our work involves harmonizing product, technology, design, risk, and other key partners to forge a modern data ecosystem. Within Enterprise Data, our team features one of the most highly-engaged, creative tech partnerships, experimenting with AI enablement tools, bringing product rigor to how we measure success, and cultivating a culture of relentless innovation and customer obsession.

About the Role
A Director of AI Enablement Product Management is a strategic hands-on product leader who will fundamentally rethink how the eData product organization - and ultimately Capital One - works with AI. You will act as the tip of the spear in driving enterprise-wide adoption of AI workflows, transforming our operations at every level: the tools we build, the processes we follow, and the mechanisms we use to measure success.  Unlike traditional product managers who focus on deterministic software features, or AI-native product managers who train foundational models, an enablement product manager focuses on the operational layer: transforming AI capabilities, architecture blueprints, and developer platforms into scalable productivity tools and resilient infrastructure.

Specifically, the Director will:
- AI Platform Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year product roadmap for internal AI infrastructure tailored to enterprise operations.
- Intelligent Workflows: Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents and advanced RAG systems to transform high-friction processes.
- Blueprint & Standard Rollout: Create and deploy enterprise patterns, guardrails, and AI architectures across engineering and non-engineering functions for a faster, better quality outcome of the product development process, embedding responsible AI practices (transparency, explainability, compliance).
- Workflow Transformation: Replace manual toil and high-friction processes with reusable platform components and AI agents.
- Data Democratization & Integration: Build intuitive AI-driven semantic layers and integrate agentic AI/ML capabilities into core front-to-back workflows via flexible integration techniques (API, MCP, CLI).
- Governance, Compliance & Security: Establish ironclad LLM evaluation pipelines and guardrails that ensure strict data privacy, compliance, and zero-hallucination thresholds for reporting.
- Adoption & Change Management: Partner with internal champions and partners to ensure behavioral adoption rather than just feature deployment.
- Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as the primary strategic translator between core data engineering teams, corporate finance executives, legal teams, and business unit leaders.
- Feedback Loops: Serve as the structured bridge between business users and core infrastructure or engineering teams to refine future product strategy.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 5 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

Senior Director, Technical Program Management

Are you interested in leading programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale data products & platforms?

At Capital One, we’re changing banking for good. We were founded on the belief that no one should be locked out of the financial system. We’re dedicated to helping foster a world where everyone has an equal opportunity to prosper.

We’re a bank, but we don’t think like one. We’re always thinking about what’s next, about how we can innovate and inspire, and about how we can develop the tools our customers need to improve their financial lives - by leveraging best in class technology. That’s where you come in.

What You’ll Do:
We are seeking an exceptional Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive Capital One’s AI and ML platforms at the heart of the company’s real-time information strategy. We work at the intersection of generative AI research and enterprise-scale systems, and our technologies span the AI and ML training and production lifecycle end-to-end, including agentic AI architectures; multi-agent conversational systems; LLM inference; ML model training, fine-tuning and monitoring; and much more. You will collaborate closely with world-class researchers, engineers, business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to take AI initiatives from concept to production, delivering high-reliability, real-time delightful experiences for our customers across all our lines of business (credit card, retail banking, auto finance, etc.)

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to show the organization what a great TPM can achieve.

- Strong technical backgrounds (ideally building highly scalable platforms, products, or services) with the ability to proactively identify and mitigate technical risks throughout delivery life-cycle
- Led technology focused discussions with senior leadership by providing valuable insights and recommendations that guide technology-based decisions
- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills
- Excellent problem solving and influencing skills
- A quantitative approach to problem solving and a collaborative implementer to holistic solutions; a systems thinker
- Experience helping grow and mentor fellow TPMs, while also building the foundations for the TPM practice
- Ability to simplify the technically complex and drive well-educated decisions across product, engineering, design, and data science representatives
- Deep focus on execution, follow-through, accountability, and results
- Exceptional cross-team collaboration; able to work across different functions, organizations, and reporting boundaries to get the job done.
- Highly tuned emotional intelligence, are good listeners, and possess deep-seated empathy for teams and partners

Basic Qualifications:

• 9+ years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing.

AI/ML software product or system development experience

Senior Manager, Product Management, Google MCP & Agent Access

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About the Role
As the Senior Manager of Product Management for Google MCP & Agent Access, you will lead the strategy and development of Capital One's approach to secure, governed access for third-party AI agents into Google Workspace. In this highly visible role, you will govern how agentic tools such as Claude Code read and write Google Workspace data on an associate's behalf. You will empower associates to integrate agents with Google Workspace APIs through a single, reusable governance pattern. Beyond building the access layer itself, you will drive the shift in how associates work day to day, helping move away from manually downloading and storing stale copies of Workspace content, and toward AI agents that collaborate with live data where associates already work, safely and efficiently. This is a high impact role, shaping how AI agents interact with the productivity tools used by tens of thousands of associates across Capital One. We are looking for a collaborative, technically curious, and user focused product manager who thrives in ambiguity and is passionate about shaping the future of AI within Capital One.

In this role you will:

- Define the GWS Agent Access Strategy: Own the roadmap for how third-party AI agents access Google Workspace context and actions, from read-only access today toward read/write and create actions over time.

- Build the API & MCP Broker Layer: Drive the build of the API/broker layer that lets agentic tools act on Google Workspace on an associate's behalf, including potential future MCP solutions.

- Drive Adoption & Behavior Change: Lead the shift away from associates manually downloading and storing local, stale copies of Workspace content, toward relying on agents that read and act on live data in the tools associates already use.

- Define Safe & Efficient Usage Patterns: Beyond building the underlying access layer, establish guidance and guardrails for how agents should be used — balancing efficiency gains against the risk of ungoverned agent actions on sensitive or high-stakes work.

- Drive Security and Compliance: Partner closely with Risk and Cyber teams to ensure all agent-initiated API calls are authenticated, authorized, and audited.

Capital One Product Framework
In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:
- Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
- Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
- Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
- Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
- Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:  - A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing

OR

- Bachelor's degree in any field and 4 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Management - Card Decisioning Platforms
jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Product Management - Card Decisioning Platforms

Product Management
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

About the Team:

Capital One’s Card Decisioning Platforms are at the forefront of innovation in creating breakthrough capabilities in our lending ecosystem that benefit hundreds of millions of Americans and fuel growth company-wide. To create focus and ownership for critical business processes, we are building an Acquisitions Service team with the mission to operate an industry-leading Acquisitions Experience for Capital One Card. We will oversee Card’s Acquisition agenda and be the bridge between our reusable platform capabilities and the business units who leverage these capabilities to provide seamless end-to-end experiences to Capital One’s customers.

We are seeking a Product Manager who can work horizontally across platforms & organizations to solve complex problems within our decisioning ecosystem. You will be an individual contributor leading a delivery team in executing our product vision for Acquisitions as a service on the Decisioning Platform.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas :
- Human Centered
- You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design

- You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

- Business Focused
- Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs

- You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

- Technology Driven
- You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology

- You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers

- You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

- Transformational Leadership
- By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams

- You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:
- Intellectually Curious . You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges

- Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you

- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work

- Passionate & Customer Focus . You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs

- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help

- Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or military experience

- At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering

- 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products

- 1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences

- 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

Manager, Product Manager - Enterprise Payments - Core Platform

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About the Team
Capital One’s Enterprise Payments team is defining the roadmap that will enable the bank’s overall digital payments strategy, modernizing existing payment types and introducing the latest innovations. In an industry rooted in mainframe systems and batch processes, we are driving toward a cloud-based, API/microservice architected, real-time data environment. The world is moving toward faster payments and Capital One is not just ahead of the curve, but defining it. We are a tech-centric company and an innovation laboratory within the only founder-led, top 10 bank in the U.S.

The Product Manager for the Enterprise Payments team plays a critical role in achieving our goals.  This is a highly collaborative role, where the individual will work closely with a team of product managers as well partnering with designers, engineers, data scientists, operations, and business partners to transform the experience for all of our customers. Through this collaboration, the individual will shape the product strategy and then develop, launch, and enhance payments experiences that will meet the unique needs of our customers, ranging from consumer to small business to commercial personas across both lending and deposit products.

Your product forms the technical backbone of Capital One's payments ecosystem — the platform through which every payment rail, line of business, and channel connects, orchestrates, and settles. Our core is not a customer-facing product; it is the platform that makes every  customer-facing payment possible. You will define the capabilities, contracts, and standards that rail teams build against: the SDK that governs how payment events flow across ACH, Wire, RTP, FedNow, and Check; the orchestration layers that ensures transactions complete reliably or compensate gracefully; the observability and resiliency infrastructure that keeps hundreds of millions of transactions moving at scale. To fit the bill, you will need deep fluency in platform product thinking — defining developer experience, API contracts, and integration patterns with the same rigor that a consumer PM applies to a customer journey. You'll need to be equally comfortable debating architectural tradeoffs with engineers as you are translating platform investment into business value for the leaders and lines of business who depend on us as their clearing destination.
